start: Admin app, owner signed in, a workout plan ready to send to two members

steps.action: Make a plan with a name, one routine of exercises, pick two members, save
user_sees: The plan saved in the gym's plan list
must_not: The plan saved under a maker name the device wrote instead of the signed-in owner

steps.action: One of the two members opens the Workout tab in the member app
user_sees: The plan's routines shown as from the gym and the owner's name
must_not: The plan missing for a picked member whose number was matched at a check-in

start: Admin app, owner signed in, a gym plan 'Monthly' with three members on it

steps.action: Make a plan and send it to the gym plan 'Monthly' instead of picking members
user_sees: The plan saved
must_not: Members on other gym plans getting it

steps.action: A member whose 'Monthly' membership covers today opens the Workout tab
user_sees: The plan shown
must_not: The plan shown to a member whose membership ended yesterday or starts tomorrow

start: Admin app, owner signed in, making a plan

steps.action: Save a plan with no routine, or 15 routines, or a name of 81 letters, or 31 exercises in one routine
user_sees: The save refused with an error
must_not: Part of the plan saved
Members getting a plan that breaks their app

steps.action: Try to delete a sent plan for good
user_sees: The delete refused; the plan can only be withdrawn
must_not: The plan removed with no record left

start: A plan already sent to a member

steps.action: Withdraw the plan in the admin app
user_sees: The plan marked withdrawn in the list
must_not: The plan deleted from the gym's records

steps.action: The member opens the Workout tab
user_sees: The plan no longer listed from the gym
must_not: The withdrawn plan still listed

steps.action: Send the plan again (withdrawn switched off)
user_sees: The plan back on the member's Workout tab, still named for the person who first made it
must_not: The maker's name changed to whoever saved last

start: Two members of the gym, a plan picked for member A only, a second gym with its own plans

steps.action: Member B and a member of the second gym open their Workout tab
user_sees: Only plans sent to them
must_not: Member A's plan shown to member B
Another gym's plan shown

steps.action: Member A's family member who shares A's mobile on the gym list opens the app
user_sees: A message that the number is shared, no plans
must_not: A's plan shown to the family member

start: Admin app, a trainer signed in on a front-desk session

steps.action: Make a plan for a member and save
user_sees: The plan saved
must_not: The save refused for a trainer
The plan stamped with the owner's name

steps.action: The member opens the Workout tab
user_sees: The plan shown as from the gym and the trainer's own name
must_not: Another staff member's name shown

start: Admin app, trainer signed in, a plan the owner made

steps.action: Try to delete the plan for good
user_sees: The delete refused
must_not: The plan removed

steps.action: Save the plan with a device copy that names someone else as its maker
user_sees: The plan saved, still named for the owner who made it
must_not: The maker name taken from the device

start: A plan the trainer sent last week

steps.action: Add a routine and save again
user_sees: The newer plan saved
must_not: A second copy of the plan made

steps.action: The member opens the Workout tab
user_sees: The changed plan with the new routine
must_not: The old version kept beside the new one

start: Member app, number matched at a check-in, first name matches the gym list, one plan sent to the member

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: The plan's routines from the gym, with the maker's name
must_not: An empty list when a plan was sent
Another member's plan

start: Member app, no plan picked for the member, but their gym plan 'Monthly' has one

steps.action: Renew to 'Monthly' at the desk, then open the Workout tab
user_sees: The 'Monthly' workout plan appears
must_not: The plan missing after the renewal starts today

start: Member app, the member never checked in with their number, or their first name differs from the gym list

steps.action: Open the Workout tab
user_sees: A message naming the gym and why no plans can be shown (no number matched, or the name does not match)
must_not: Plans of the gym member with that number shown
A crash or endless loading

start: Member app showing a plan sent through the member's gym plan

steps.action: The membership ends; next day open the Workout tab
user_sees: That plan no longer shown
must_not: The plan still shown after the cover ended

steps.action: The gym withdraws a second plan
user_sees: The second plan gone too
must_not: A withdrawn plan still shown

start: Member app, two family members share one mobile on the gym list

steps.action: Open the Workout tab on either phone
user_sees: A message that the number is shared, no plans
must_not: One member's plan shown to the other
